name: Agent Ticket Report
report_script:
# Agent Ticket Report — non-standard Script Report (Report doctype, field "report_script"). # Runs inside Frappe safe_exec: no imports; `filters`, `frappe`, `json` are provided. # Script-level names are not visible inside `def` functions, so helpers take them as args. # Read-only: SELECT queries only, all user input passed as SQL parameters. # # Agent empty -> all tickets in the range (every agent, plus unassigned ones). Totals stay ALL # tickets, but per-agent views cover only HD Team "Technical" members (managed at # /helpdesk/teams; empty/missing team falls back to all active HD Agents). # Agent chosen -> only tickets whose _assign JSON contains that user; a comma-separated # list selects several agents at once (a ticket matches any of them). # View "Summary per Agent" -> one row per agent instead of one row per ticket. # View "Bajaaj Expense by Company" -> GL account 5225 per customer (exportable, with totals). # # Bajaaj expenses: GL Entry on BAJAAJ_ACCOUNT by posting_date within From/To. The customer comes from # Expense Bill.customer (or the GL party when it is a Customer), the agent from Expense Bill.employee # -> Employee.user_id, the ticket from Expense Bill.hd_ticket. Only users with read access to GL Entry # get any expense numbers. ALLOWED_ROLES = ["Agent Manager", "System Manager", "Administrator"] user_roles = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql( "SELECT role FROM `tabHas Role` WHERE parenttype = 'User' AND parent = %(user)s", {"user": frappe.session.user}, )] if frappe.session.user != "Administrator" and not [r for r in user_roles if r in ALLOWED_ROLES]: frappe.throw("Only Agent Manager / System Manager can run this report.") agent = filters.get("agent") from_date = filters.get("from_date") or frappe.utils.get_first_day(frappe.utils.nowdate()) to_date = filters.get("to_date") or frappe.utils.nowdate() based_on = filters.get("based_on") or "Opening Date" view = filters.get("view") or "Tickets" from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(from_date) to_date = frappe.utils.getdate(to_date) if from_date > to_date: frappe.throw("From Date cannot be after To Date.") # One value or a comma-separated list; each entry resolves HD Agent -> user id. agent_users = [] for part in (str(agent).split(",") if agent else []): part = part.strip() if part: mapped = frappe.db.get_value("HD Agent", part, "user") or part if mapped not in agent_users: agent_users.append(mapped) # Technical team members: the only agents this report breaks down by. Managed in HD Team # "Technical" (Helpdesk admin UI /helpdesk/teams). Empty/missing team -> all active agents. tech_users = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql( "SELECT user FROM `tabHD Team Member`" " WHERE parenttype = 'HD Team' AND parent = 'Technical' AND COALESCE(user, '') != ''" )] if not tech_users: tech_users = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql( "SELECT COALESCE(user, name) FROM `tabHD Agent` WHERE is_active = 1" )] non_tech = [u for u in agent_users if u not in tech_users] if non_tech: frappe.throw( "Only Technical team members can be selected as Agent: " + ", ".join(non_tech) + ". Manage members in HD Team 'Technical' (Helpdesk > Teams)." ) # Column for the date filter comes from a fixed whitelist, never from user input. if based_on == "Resolution Date": date_expr = "DATE(t.resolution_date)" else: based_on = "Opening Date" date_expr = "t.opening_date" values = {"from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date} conditions = [date_expr + " BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s"] if agent_users: # Exact quoted match inside the _assign JSON, with LIKE wildcards escaped; any selected agent matches. like_parts = [] i = 0 for au in agent_users: escaped = au.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_") key = "assign_pat_" + str(i) values[key] = '%"' + escaped + '"%' like_parts.append("t._assign LIKE %(" + key + ")s") i = i + 1 conditions.append("(" + " OR ".join(like_parts) + ")") if filters.get("status"): conditions.append("t.status = %(status)s") values["status"] = filters.get("status") if filters.get("customer"): conditions.append("t.customer = %(customer)s") values["customer"] = filters.get("customer") if filters.get("status_category"): conditions.append("COALESCE(s.category, t.status_category) = %(status_category)s") values["status_category"] = filters.get("status_category") if filters.get("source_team"): # Ka yimid / Raised by team (HD Ticket.source_team: Sales / Technical). conditions.append("t.source_team = %(source_team)s") values["source_team"] = filters.get("source_team") rows = frappe.db.sql( "SELECT t.name, t.subject, t.status, COALESCE(s.category, t.status_category) AS category," " t.priority, t.customer, COALESCE(t.erp_customer_name, cu.customer_name) AS company," " COALESCE(t.primary_contact_name, pc.full_name) AS primary_contact," " t.contact, t.raised_by, t.caller_name, t.caller_phone, t.ticket_type, t.source_team," " t.opening_date, t.opening_time, t.first_responded_on, t.resolution_date," " t.first_response_time, t.resolution_time, t.agreement_status, t._assign AS assign_json," " " + date_expr + " AS bucket_date" " FROM `tabHD Ticket` t" " LEFT JOIN `tabHD Ticket Status` s ON s.name = t.status" " LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` cu ON cu.name = t.customer" " LEFT JOIN `tabContact` pc ON pc.name = cu.customer_primary_contact" " WHERE " + " AND ".join(conditions) + " ORDER BY t.opening_date DESC, t.creation DESC", values, as_dict=True, ) # user id -> display name (HD Agent name, else User full name, else the id). agent_names = {} for a in frappe.db.sql("SELECT name, agent_name FROM `tabHD Agent`", as_dict=True): agent_names[a.name] = a.agent_name or a.name def assignees(assign_json): try: users = json.loads(assign_json or "[]") or [] except Exception: users = [] return [u for u in users if u] def display_name(user, names): if user not in names: names[user] = frappe.db.get_value("User", user, "full_name") or user return names[user] def to_hours(seconds, start, end): # Prefer the stored Duration (seconds); fall back to the timestamp difference. if seconds: return frappe.utils.flt(seconds / 3600.0, 2) if start and end: diff = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(end, start) if diff >= 0: return frappe.utils.flt(diff / 3600.0, 2) return None def stats(items): total = len(items) resolved = len([d for d in items if d["category"] == "Resolved" or d["status"] in ("Resolved", "Closed")]) failed = len([d for d in items if d["agreement_status"] == "Failed"]) fulfilled = len([d for d in items if d["agreement_status"] == "Fulfilled"]) frt = [d["first_response_hours"] for d in items if d["first_response_hours"] is not None] rt = [d["resolution_hours"] for d in items if d["resolution_hours"] is not None] return { "total": total, "resolved": resolved, "open": total - resolved, "sla_failed": failed, "sla_pct": frappe.utils.flt(fulfilled * 100.0 / (fulfilled + failed), 1) if (fulfilled + failed) else 0, "avg_frt": frappe.utils.flt(sum(frt) / len(frt), 2) if frt else 0, "avg_rt": frappe.utils.flt(sum(rt) / len(rt), 2) if rt else 0, } tickets = [] per_day = {} per_agent = {} # user id ("" = unassigned) -> list of ticket rows for r in rows: users = assignees(r.assign_json) if agent_users and not [u for u in users if u in agent_users]: continue opened_at = None if r.opening_date: opened_at = frappe.utils.get_datetime(str(r.opening_date) + " " + str(r.opening_time or "00:00:00")) row = { "name": r.name, "subject": r.subject, "status": r.status, "category": r.category, "assigned_to": ", ".join([display_name(u, agent_names) for u in users]) or "Unassigned", "priority": r.priority, "customer": r.customer, "company": r.company, "primary_contact": r.primary_contact, "contact": r.contact or r.raised_by, "caller_name": r.caller_name, "caller_phone": r.caller_phone, "ticket_type": r.ticket_type, "source_team": r.source_team, "opening_date": r.opening_date, "first_responded_on": r.first_responded_on, "resolution_date": r.resolution_date, "first_response_hours": to_hours(r.first_response_time, opened_at, r.first_responded_on), "resolution_hours": to_hours(r.resolution_time, opened_at, r.resolution_date) if r.resolution_date else None, "agreement_status": r.agreement_status, } tickets.append(row) key = str(r.bucket_date) per_day[key] = per_day.get(key, 0) + 1 # A ticket with two assignees counts for both agents. Per-agent sections cover only # Technical team members (the overall totals above still count every ticket). for u in users: if agent_users and u not in agent_users: continue if u not in tech_users: continue per_agent.setdefault(u, []).append(row) # ---------- Bajaaj expenses (GL account 5225) ---------- BAJAAJ_ACCOUNT = "5225 - Bajaaj Expense - YT" # Read access to GL Entry: Custom DocPerm replaces the standard DocPerm when it exists. can_see_expense = frappe.session.user == "Administrator" if not can_see_expense and user_roles: perm_table = "tabCustom DocPerm" if frappe.db.sql( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabCustom DocPerm` WHERE parent = 'GL Entry'" )[0][0] else "tabDocPerm" can_see_expense = bool(frappe.db.sql( "SELECT 1 FROM `" + perm_table + "` WHERE parent = 'GL Entry' AND permlevel = 0 AND `read` = 1" " AND role IN %(roles)s LIMIT 1", {"roles": tuple(user_roles)}, )) if view == "Bajaaj Expense by Company" and not can_see_expense: frappe.throw("You need read access to GL Entry to see Bajaaj expenses.") expense_total = 0 expense_currency = None expense_by_ticket = {} expense_by_customer = {} unlinked = [] if can_see_expense: expense_currency = frappe.db.get_value( "Company", frappe.db.get_value("Account", BAJAAJ_ACCOUNT, "company"), "default_currency" ) customer_expr = "COALESCE(eb.customer, IF(gle.party_type = 'Customer', gle.party, NULL))" e_values = {"account": BAJAAJ_ACCOUNT, "from_date": from_date, "to_date": to_date} # account + posting_date are both indexed on GL Entry. e_conditions = [ "gle.account = %(account)s", "gle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s", "gle.is_cancelled = 0", ] if filters.get("customer"): e_conditions.append(customer_expr + " = %(customer)s") e_values["customer"] = filters.get("customer") if agent_users: # Agent filter only matches expenses that record the agent (Employee.user_id). e_conditions.append("emp.user_id IN %(agent_users)s") e_values["agent_users"] = tuple(agent_users) expenses = frappe.db.sql( "SELECT gle.voucher_type, gle.voucher_no, SUM(gle.debit - gle.credit) AS amount," " " + customer_expr + " AS expense_customer, cu.customer_name, eb.hd_ticket" " FROM `tabGL Entry` gle" " LEFT JOIN `tabExpense Bill` eb ON gle.voucher_type = 'Expense Bill' AND eb.name = gle.voucher_no" " LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = eb.employee" " LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` cu ON cu.name = " + customer_expr + " WHERE " + " AND ".join(e_conditions) + " GROUP BY gle.voucher_type, gle.voucher_no, expense_customer, cu.customer_name, eb.hd_ticket", e_values, as_dict=True, ) for e in expenses: amount = frappe.utils.flt(e.amount, 2) expense_total += amount if e.hd_ticket: expense_by_ticket[e.hd_ticket] = expense_by_ticket.get(e.hd_ticket, 0) + amount if e.expense_customer: bucket = expense_by_customer.setdefault( e.expense_customer, {"customer": e.expense_customer, "company": e.customer_name or e.expense_customer, "entries": 0, "amount": 0, "ticket_linked": 0}, ) # RestrictedPython rejects "+=" on dict items. bucket["entries"] = bucket["entries"] + 1 bucket["amount"] = bucket["amount"] + amount if e.hd_ticket: bucket["ticket_linked"] = bucket["ticket_linked"] + amount else: unlinked.append({"doctype": e.voucher_type, "name": e.voucher_no, "amount": amount}) expense_total = frappe.utils.flt(expense_total, 2) tickets_per_customer = {} for t in tickets: if t["customer"]: tickets_per_customer[t["customer"]] = tickets_per_customer.get(t["customer"], 0) + 1 # Per ticket: the amount linked to it via Expense Bill.hd_ticket, plus an equal share of the company's # expenses that name no ticket (company total / its tickets in the period), so a company's tickets add # up to its total. The share is labelled as an average in the report. for t in tickets: t["bajaaj_expense"] = expense_by_ticket.get(t["name"]) t["bajaaj_share"] = None b = expense_by_customer.get(t["customer"]) if t["customer"] else None n = tickets_per_customer.get(t["customer"], 0) if t["customer"] else 0 if b and n and b["amount"] - b["ticket_linked"] > 0: t["bajaaj_share"] = frappe.utils.flt((b["amount"] - b["ticket_linked"]) / n, 2) t["currency"] = expense_currency expense_rows = [] for c in expense_by_customer: b = expense_by_customer[c] n = tickets_per_customer.get(c, 0) expense_rows.append({ "customer": b["customer"], "company": b["company"], "entries": b["entries"], "amount": frappe.utils.flt(b["amount"], 2), "tickets": n, "per_ticket": frappe.utils.flt(b["amount"] / n, 2) if n else None, "currency": expense_currency, }) expense_rows = sorted(expense_rows, key=lambda x: (-x["amount"], x["company"])) unlinked_total = frappe.utils.flt(sum([u["amount"] for u in unlinked]), 2) overall = stats(tickets) report_summary = [ {"value": overall["total"], "label": "Total Tickets", "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Blue"}, {"value": overall["resolved"], "label": "Resolved / Closed", "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Green"}, {"value": overall["open"], "label": "Still Open", "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Orange"}, {"value": overall["sla_failed"], "label": "SLA Failed", "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Red"}, {"value": overall["sla_pct"], "label": "SLA Fulfilled %", "datatype": "Percent", "indicator": "Green"}, {"value": overall["avg_frt"], "label": "Avg First Response (hrs)", "datatype": "Float", "indicator": "Blue"}, {"value": overall["avg_rt"], "label": "Avg Resolution (hrs)", "datatype": "Float", "indicator": "Blue"}, ] if can_see_expense: report_summary.append( {"value": expense_total, "label": "Bajaaj Expense", "datatype": "Currency", "currency": expense_currency, "indicator": "Orange"} ) # The page's own section ("Bajaaj expense by company" + unlinked line) is drawn by the report JS from this # payload; it travels as HTML-escaped JSON in the report message, which the JS hides. expense_message = None if can_see_expense and view != "Bajaaj Expense by Company": payload = json.dumps({ "currency": expense_currency, "total": expense_total, "rows": expense_rows, "unlinked": {"count": len(unlinked), "total": unlinked_total, "vouchers": unlinked[:200]}, }, default=str) payload = payload.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") expense_message = '
' + payload + "
" if view == "Bajaaj Expense by Company": columns = [ {"fieldname": "company", "label": "Company", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 240}, {"fieldname": "customer", "label": "Customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 160}, {"fieldname": "entries", "label": "Expense Entries", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 130}, {"fieldname": "amount", "label": "Total Bajaaj Expense", "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 170}, {"fieldname": "tickets", "label": "Tickets in Period", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 130}, {"fieldname": "per_ticket", "label": "Expense per Ticket", "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 160}, {"fieldname": "currency", "label": "Currency", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Currency", "width": 80, "hidden": 1}, ] result = list(expense_rows) if unlinked: result.append({ "company": "Unlinked expenses", "entries": len(unlinked), "amount": unlinked_total, "currency": expense_currency, "is_unlinked": 1, }) linked_tickets = sum([r["tickets"] for r in expense_rows]) result.append({ "company": "Total", "entries": sum([r["entries"] for r in expense_rows]) + len(unlinked), "amount": expense_total, "tickets": linked_tickets, "currency": expense_currency, "is_total": 1, }) top = expense_rows[:15] chart = { "data": {"labels": [r["company"] for r in top], "datasets": [{"name": "Bajaaj Expense", "values": [r["amount"] for r in top]}]}, "title": "Bajaaj expense by company", "type": "bar", "colors": ["#1db487"], } data = (columns, result, None, chart, report_summary) elif view == "Summary per Agent": summary_rows = [] for u in per_agent: s = stats(per_agent[u]) s["agent_user"] = u s["agent"] = display_name(u, agent_names) if u else "Unassigned" summary_rows.append(s) summary_rows = sorted(summary_rows, key=lambda x: (-x["total"], x["agent"])) columns = [ {"fieldname": "agent", "label": "Agent", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200}, {"fieldname": "agent_user", "label": "Agent ID", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "total", "label": "Total", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 90}, {"fieldname": "resolved", "label": "Resolved / Closed", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 130}, {"fieldname": "open", "label": "Open", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 90}, {"fieldname": "sla_failed", "label": "SLA Failed", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 100}, {"fieldname": "sla_pct", "label": "SLA %", "fieldtype": "Percent", "width": 90}, {"fieldname": "avg_frt", "label": "Avg First Response (hrs)", "fieldtype": "Float", "precision": 2, "width": 170}, {"fieldname": "avg_rt", "label": "Avg Resolution (hrs)", "fieldtype": "Float", "precision": 2, "width": 160}, ] chart = { "data": { "labels": [s["agent"] for s in summary_rows], "datasets": [ {"name": "Total", "values": [s["total"] for s in summary_rows]}, {"name": "Resolved / Closed", "values": [s["resolved"] for s in summary_rows]}, ], }, "title": "Tickets per agent", "type": "bar", # Figma Chart: grey (bg-gray-secondary 100) next to brand (bg-brand-bold 600). "colors": ["#dadadb", "#1db487"], } data = (columns, summary_rows, expense_message, chart, report_summary) else: columns = [ # Shown columns: the report JS draws each as two lines (main value + detail from the hidden fields # noted after it), so every field stays visible without horizontal scrolling. {"fieldname": "name", "label": "Ticket", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "HD Ticket", "width": 100}, # + opening date {"fieldname": "subject", "label": "Subject", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 240}, # + ticket type, priority {"fieldname": "status", "label": "Status / SLA", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "HD Ticket Status", "width": 130}, # + SLA {"fieldname": "assigned_to", "label": "Assigned To", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150}, {"fieldname": "source_team", "label": "Ka yimid", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100}, {"fieldname": "company", "label": "Company", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 190}, # + customer ID {"fieldname": "primary_contact", "label": "Contact", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 170}, # + contact record {"fieldname": "caller_name", "label": "Caller", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140}, # + caller phone {"fieldname": "first_response_hours", "label": "Response / Resolution", "fieldtype": "Float", "precision": 2, "width": 170}, # Hidden here but still in the data and in exports (report JS sets export_hidden_cols). {"fieldname": "priority", "label": "Priority", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "HD Ticket Priority", "width": 90, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "customer", "label": "Customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 160, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "contact", "label": "Contact Record", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "caller_phone", "label": "Caller Phone", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "ticket_type", "label": "Ticket Type", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "HD Ticket Type", "width": 120, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "opening_date", "label": "Opening Date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 105, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "first_responded_on", "label": "First Responded On", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 160, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "resolution_date", "label": "Resolution Date", "fieldtype": "Datetime", "width": 160, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "resolution_hours", "label": "Resolution Time (hrs)", "fieldtype": "Float", "precision": 2, "width": 120, "hidden": 1}, {"fieldname": "agreement_status", "label": "SLA Status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140, "hidden": 1}, ] if can_see_expense: columns.append({"fieldname": "bajaaj_expense", "label": "Bajaaj", "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120}) # + company avg share columns.append({"fieldname": "bajaaj_share", "label": "Bajaaj (company avg share)", "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120, "hidden": 1}) columns.append({"fieldname": "currency", "label": "Currency", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Currency", "width": 80, "hidden": 1}) labels = [] counts = [] day = from_date while day <= to_date: labels.append(frappe.utils.formatdate(day, "dd-MM")) counts.append(per_day.get(str(day), 0)) day = frappe.utils.add_days(day, 1) chart = { "data": {"labels": labels, "datasets": [{"name": "Tickets (" + based_on + ")", "values": counts}]}, "title": "Tickets per day", "type": "bar", # Figma Chart: bg-brand-bold (600). "colors": ["#1db487"], } data = (columns, tickets, expense_message, chart, report_summary)
